# crap4dart configuration for flutter_agent_harness.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET: the CRAP threshold is pinned at the current worst score
# (356.34, `_handleKey` in bin/../tui_repl.dart) — pushes may only make
# the codebase BETTER, never worse. Lower the threshold whenever the top
# offenders are fixed (run: dart pub global run crap4dart analyze).

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo: 12.0 (re-measured whole-tree on
  # the merged-suite lcov, #1234 rework). The card's named offenders DID
  # move — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into fake-seam /
  # platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers,
  # the four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video
  # endpoint, below-window ingest, provider picker), the named CC-9 tier
  # split, and _listModels (20 @ 0%) covered by the line-mode /models
  # test. But the FIRST real whole-tree measurement (the authoring box
  # had no dart toolchain) shows the 12.0 → 8.0 repin is not earned yet:
  # 137 methods measure above 8.0 — 54 at exactly 12.00 (the CC-3 @ 0%
  # tier + fully-covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00 (CC-9 @ 100%).
  # Threshold stays at the measured max; the 12.00/9.00 tier is the next
  # ladder card (cover the CC-3@0% half, split the CC-12 dispatchers,
  # then the threshold follows down to 8.0). Only down from here.
  threshold: 12.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries. Scope = the package sources [lib, bin]:
  # 0.11.0 has NO per-gate sources override (gates.loc.sources is a
  # ConfigException — caught by CI on 019ede65), and the top-level
  # sources drive the CRAP census too, so they stay untouched. test/ and
  # example/ are enforced by the companion config
  # crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml (same loc gate, sources [test, example]);
  # the app package's own config covers flutter_app/lib.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known
    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points
    # (lib/io.dart, lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart — public barrels whose
    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone
  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid
  # (follow-up, owner-side). The global jscpd <1% guards stay as-is.
  #
  # Two suppression channels with different contracts:
  # - `// crap:ignore` (needs ignorable: true) = a JUSTIFIED structural
  #   twin, suppressed forever, with a one-line reason in the comment.
  # - `.crap-baseline.json` (via `check --baseline`) = LEGACY debt; the
  #   committed snapshot must only SHRINK: after each triage batch re-run
  #   `dart pub global run crap4dart check --save-baseline` and commit the
  #   only-down diff, or the snapshot rots and starts masking shifts.
  #
  # WINDOW (until severity flips to error): the gate never fails a build —
  # new (not-baselined) duplication only surfaces as a `[WARN]` line in
  # `check` output. Enforcement becomes hard exactly when the owner-side
  # escalation lands; from then on any finding outside the two channels
  # fails CI/pre-commit.
  duplication:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    ignorable: true # enables `// crap:ignore` for justified structural twins
    ignore_locals: true # Type-2: rename locals before hashing (API names stay)
    ignore_literals: false # keeps l10n/theme/symbol tables out
    sources: # cross-module scope from #487
      - flutter_app/lib
      - packages/fa_ui/lib
      - packages/fa_llm/lib
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}
  golden: {enabled: false} # flutter-only gate (core is not a Flutter project)
  accessibility: {enabled: false}
  hardcoded_strings: {enabled: false}

  # Pixel gate over core test/ goldens — none exist today, so this is a
  # no-op that guards the future (issue #447 AC: "and core test/ goldens
  # if any appear"). WARNING, same rationale as flutter_app: the 0.9.5
  # detector misses the Ahem-solid-rect and hollow-square classes and
  # false-positives on V-converging shapes; flip to error when the
  # upstream detector fixes land.
  broken_goldens:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    dirs: [test]
    exclude:
      # TUI screenshots, not goldens: amber/yellow text on the dark theme
      # trips the stripe heuristic (measured 14/14 "overflow stripes" —
      # the same yellow-on-dark detector bug the issue documents for
      # apps_panel/panel_dark). Revisit when upstream fixes land.
      - 'test/integration/**'

# Changelog

on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose

bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- gh-1577: an empty assistant completion after partial content (assistant
  text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is a
  bounded-retry provider hiccup — up to `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3)
  re-streams with exponential backoff (`emptyHiccupBaseDelay`,
  `emptyHiccupMaxBackoff`, both threaded through the `Agent` facade,
  `AgentWiringSpec`, and the CLI config), and exhaustion ends the run with
  a loud `StopReason.error` (headless exit 1, interactive error + prompt)
  instead of the silent exit-0 settle that killed the gh-1577 trials.

  wins: a cancel racing the final retry settles `StopReason.aborted` for

  backoff sleep is cancellation-aware.

# crap4dart configuration for flutter_agent_harness.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET: the CRAP threshold is pinned at the current worst score
# (356.34, `_handleKey` in bin/../tui_repl.dart) — pushes may only make
# the codebase BETTER, never worse. Lower the threshold whenever the top
# offenders are fixed (run: dart pub global run crap4dart analyze).

sources: [lib, bin]

exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'
  - 'vendor/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in the repo: 12.0 (re-measured whole-tree on
  # the merged-suite lcov, #1234 rework). The card's named offenders DID
  # move — readPasteboardImage 16.32 (split into fake-seam /
  # platform-dispatch helpers), the CC-12 trio (_handleTreeKey,
  # discoverTaskAgents, _rebuild) split into cohesive sub-dispatchers,
  # the four 0%-cov CC-3 methods covered by tests (frontmatter, video
  # endpoint, below-window ingest, provider picker), the named CC-9 tier
  # split, and _listModels (20 @ 0%) covered by the line-mode /models
  # test. But the FIRST real whole-tree measurement (the authoring box
  # had no dart toolchain) shows the 12.0 → 8.0 repin is not earned yet:
  # 137 methods measure above 8.0 — 54 at exactly 12.00 (the CC-3 @ 0%
  # tier + fully-covered CC-12 dispatchers) and 83 at 9.00 (CC-9 @ 100%).
  # Threshold stays at the measured max; the 12.00/9.00 tier is the next
  # ladder card (cover the CC-3@0% half, split the CC-12 dispatchers,
  # then the threshold follows down to 8.0). Only down from here.
  threshold: 12.0
  # _listModels used to hit 20 with 0% coverage (line-mode-only output);
  # covered by test/cli/provider_models_line_mode_test.dart in #1234.

# ─── loc gate (issue #1234, gh-1232 migration) ─────────────────────────────
# The ≤2800-line file guard MOVED from scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh stage_size +
# the ci.yml shell find-exec guards onto crap4dart's `loc` gate (0.11.0,
# maintainer-confirmed wc -l semantics). Enforced whole-tree on every merge
# validation via `crap4dart check --baseline` (CI quality-gates step) and
# staged files in the pre-commit hook — no staged-scoping escape, no
# hook-dependence, merge-bot merges included. max_lines only DOWN;
# app_localizations.dart is gen-l10n OUTPUT (no .g.dart suffix) — excluded,
# not baselined.

coverage:
  # scripts/pre-commit regenerates this (dart test --coverage) right
  # before the CRAP step runs.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  branch_coverage: true
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole core suite first.
  # Coverage is regenerated explicitly (pre-commit hook, CI shard merge);
  # do not pay for it twice.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.9.5 default-enables ALL built-in gates; only broken_goldens is
# enforced here, everything else is disabled explicitly so a bare
# `check --staged` (pre-commit, core-only #433 split) means exactly the
# pixel gate. The flutter_app goldens live in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: the whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was stage_size +
  # ci.yml shell find-exec, gh-1232). wc -l semantics, generated output
  # excluded — nothing exceeds 2800 today, so the shrink-only baseline
  # starts EMPTY of loc entries. Scope = the package sources [lib, bin]:
  # 0.11.0 has NO per-gate sources override (gates.loc.sources is a
  # ConfigException — caught by CI on 019ede65), and the top-level
  # sources drive the CRAP census too, so they stay untouched. test/ and
  # example/ are enforced by the companion config
  # crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml (same loc gate, sources [test, example]);
  # the app package's own config covers flutter_app/lib.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - '**.g.dart'
      - '**.freezed.dart'
      - '**.mocks.dart'
      - 'vendor/**'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet above already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false} # follow-up card (issue #1234 §5). Known
    # FPs to exclude when enabling: the conditional-export IO entry points
    # (lib/io.dart, lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart — public barrels whose
    # importers live outside this repo's import graph) and shared pinned
    # data modules imported only from test/ (lib/src/cli/omp_reg_scenarios.dart,
    # issue #810). lib/fanet.dart was the one confirmed-dead hit — deleted
    # in #1234.
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  # Type-2 duplication gate (issue #1106, crap4dart 0.11.0). Renamed-clone
  # detection on top of the Type-1 default; the union with the raw pass can
  # only ADD findings, never lose exact copies. severity: warning starts
  # soft — escalate to error once the 13-file triage debt is paid
  # (follow-up, owner-side). The global jscpd <1% guards stay as-is.
  #
  # Two suppression channels with different contracts:
  # - `// crap:ignore` (needs ignorable: true) = a JUSTIFIED structural
  #   twin, suppressed forever, with a one-line reason in the comment.
  # - `.crap-baseline.json` (via `check --baseline`) = LEGACY debt; the
  #   committed snapshot must only SHRINK: after each triage batch re-run
  #   `dart pub global run crap4dart check --save-baseline` and commit the
  #   only-down diff, or the snapshot rots and starts masking shifts.
  #
  # WINDOW (until severity flips to error): the gate never fails a build —
  # new (not-baselined) duplication only surfaces as a `[WARN]` line in
  # `check` output. Enforcement becomes hard exactly when the owner-side
  # escalation lands; from then on any finding outside the two channels
  # fails CI/pre-commit.
  duplication:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    ignorable: true # enables `// crap:ignore` for justified structural twins
    ignore_locals: true # Type-2: rename locals before hashing (API names stay)
    ignore_literals: false # keeps l10n/theme/symbol tables out
    sources: # cross-module scope from #487
      - flutter_app/lib
      - packages/fa_ui/lib
      - packages/fa_llm/lib
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}
  golden: {enabled: false} # flutter-only gate (core is not a Flutter project)
  accessibility: {enabled: false}
  hardcoded_strings: {enabled: false}

  # Pixel gate over core test/ goldens — none exist today, so this is a
  # no-op that guards the future (issue #447 AC: "and core test/ goldens
  # if any appear"). WARNING, same rationale as flutter_app: the 0.9.5
  # detector misses the Ahem-solid-rect and hollow-square classes and
  # false-positives on V-converging shapes; flip to error when the
  # upstream detector fixes land.
  broken_goldens:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    dirs: [test]
    exclude:
      # TUI screenshots, not goldens: amber/yellow text on the dark theme
      # trips the stripe heuristic (measured 14/14 "overflow stripes" —
      # the same yellow-on-dark detector bug the issue documents for
      # apps_panel/panel_dark). Revisit when upstream fixes land.
      - 'test/integration/**'

# Changelog

bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- gh-1577: an empty assistant completion after partial content (assistant
  text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is a
  bounded-retry provider hiccup — up to `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3)
  re-streams with exponential backoff (`emptyHiccupBaseDelay`,
  `emptyHiccupMaxBackoff`, both threaded through the `Agent` facade,
  `AgentWiringSpec`, and the CLI config), and exhaustion ends the run with
  a loud `StopReason.error` (headless exit 1, interactive error + prompt)
  instead of the silent exit-0 settle that killed the gh-1577 trials.
  Clean empties keep the #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics. The abort always
  wins: a cancel racing the final retry settles `StopReason.aborted` for
  any empty shape (the exit-contract race is pinned by tests), and the
  backoff sleep is cancellation-aware.

# Changelog

bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

  text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is a
  bounded-retry provider hiccup — up to `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3)
  re-streams with exponential backoff (`emptyHiccupBaseDelay`,
  `emptyHiccupMaxBackoff`, both threaded through the `Agent` facade,
  `AgentWiringSpec`, and the CLI config), and exhaustion ends the run with
  a loud `StopReason.error` (headless exit 1, interactive error + prompt)
  instead of the silent exit-0 settle that killed the gh-1577 trials.

  backoff sleep is cancellation-aware.

# Changelog

bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- gh-1577: an empty assistant completion after partial content (assistant
  text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is a
  bounded-retry provider hiccup — up to `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3)
  re-streams with exponential backoff (`emptyHiccupBaseDelay`,
  `emptyHiccupMaxBackoff`, both threaded through the `Agent` facade,
  `AgentWiringSpec`, and the CLI config), and exhaustion ends the run with
  a loud `StopReason.error` (headless exit 1, interactive error + prompt)
  instead of the silent exit-0 settle that killed the gh-1577 trials.

  backoff sleep is cancellation-aware.

# Changelog

on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose

bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

  text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is a
  bounded-retry provider hiccup — up to `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3)
  re-streams with exponential backoff (`emptyHiccupBaseDelay`,
  `emptyHiccupMaxBackoff`, both threaded through the `Agent` facade,
  `AgentWiringSpec`, and the CLI config), and exhaustion ends the run with

  instead of the silent exit-0 settle that killed the gh-1577 trials.
  Clean empties keep the #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics. The abort always
  wins: a cancel racing the final retry settles `StopReason.aborted` for
  any empty shape (the exit-contract race is pinned by tests), and the
  backoff sleep is cancellation-aware.

# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- gh-1577: an empty assistant completion after partial content (assistant
  text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is a
  bounded-retry provider hiccup — up to `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3)
  re-streams with exponential backoff (`emptyHiccupBaseDelay`,
  `emptyHiccupMaxBackoff`, both threaded through the `Agent` facade,
  `AgentWiringSpec`, and the CLI config), and exhaustion ends the run with
  a loud `StopReason.error` (headless exit 1, interactive error + prompt)
  instead of the silent exit-0 settle that killed the gh-1577 trials.
  Clean empties keep the #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics. The abort always
  wins: a cancel racing the final retry settles `StopReason.aborted` for
  any empty shape (the exit-contract race is pinned by tests), and the
  backoff sleep is cancellation-aware.

- gh-1556: bench pipeline stops bleeding score + fa deadline awareness.

# gh-1606 — Copilot provider: fine-grained PAT support (PAT mode) + `/provider export` ### What changed - The `copilot` provider now accepts fine-grained PATs (`github_pat_…`) **directly**: when the GitHub credential is a PAT, the `copilot_internal/v2/token` exchange is skipped entirely and the raw PAT rides as the Bearer against the configured Copilot base URL (the seat's tier host — a PAT has no `proxy-ep` to learn a tenant host from), with the official Copilot CLI's first-party identity headers (`copilot-integration-id: copilot-developer-cli`, `user-agent: copilot/ () term/unknown`). This is the only request shape the Copilot API accepts a PAT with; `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN=github_pat_…` now works headless. - New `/provider export`: copies the saved Copilot account's full token to the clipboard (single account = no ceremony; several = the existing account picker; feedback is one line `token copied to clipboard`; the token never prints to the transcript). - Connect flow updated: the PAT paste hint explains direct-PAT mode (device flow stays recommended); a dead PAT surfaces at the model fetch ("no models for this PAT — check Copilot Requests permission/seat") instead of a forecast exchange 404. ### Key decisions - **PAT mode lives in the token source**: `CopilotTokenManager.get()` short-circuits PATs (no exchange, no cache, no refresh); `copilotRequestHeaders()` dispatches request headers by token shape — an exchanged token keeps the `vscode-chat` identity byte-for-byte, a PAT presents `copilot-developer-cli`. The 401/403 refresh-retry is skipped in PAT mode (nothing to refresh — no doomed retry). - The `/models` dialect gets the same split: PAT → `GET {configured-base}/models` with PAT headers; OAuth → existing exchange + `proxy-ep` derivation, untouched. - Version/OS for the user-agent are host-installed at startup (`installCopilotCliIdentity` in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`) — `lib/` stays pure Dart. - Clipboard writes go through a new `clipboard_writer.dart` (pbcopy / xclip→wl-copy / clip; the token rides **stdin**, never argv) behind the same web-safe conditional-import pattern as the pasteboard reader, plus an `AgentCliConfig.clipboardWrite` test seam. - OAuth path unchanged: exchange, proactive ~30-min refresh, 401 refresh+retry all preserved (existing tests green). ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/providers/copilot_test.dart # PAT mode group: no exchange, PAT bearer + identity headers, chat + /models dart test test/cli/copilot_provider_test.dart test/cli/clipboard_writer_test.dart ``` Docs: `docs/agents/providers.md` (new "GitHub Copilot credentials" table — device flow recommended / `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN` env as OAuth or fine-grained PAT / classic `ghp_` never supported), README Copilot section, CHANGELOG under Unreleased. **Not verified here**: the live smoke against a real Copilot Business seat (AC2) — this ephemeral CI runner holds no Copilot-seat credential; AC1's mocked-http tests cover the wire shape the smoke would check.
Request flow ```mermaid flowchart TD CRED[GitHub credential] -->|gho_/ghu_ OAuth| EX[POST copilot_internal/v2/token exchange] EX --> TOK[~30-min Copilot API token + proxy-ep host] CRED -->|github_pat_ PAT| PAT[raw PAT is the Bearer] TOK --> API[copilot API base URL] PAT --> API API --> HDR[vscode-chat identity · OAuth
copilot-developer-cli + copilot/<version> UA · PAT] HDR --> MODELS[GET /models] HDR --> CHAT[POST /chat/completions] ```

{"content":"# gh-1606 — Copilot provider: fine-grained PAT support (PAT mode) + `/provider export` ### What changed - The `copilot` provider now accepts fine-grained PATs (`github_pat_…`) **directly**: when the GitHub credential is a PAT, the `copilot_internal/v2/token` exchange is skipped entirely and the raw PAT rides as the Bearer against the configured Copilot base URL (the seat's tier host — a PAT has no `proxy-ep` to learn a tenant host from), with the official Copilot CLI's first-party identity headers (`copilot-integration-id: copilot-developer-cli`, `user-agent: copilot/ () term/unknown`). This is the only request shape the Copilot API accepts a PAT with; `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN=github_pat_…` now works headless. - New `/provider export`: copies the saved Copilot account's full token to the clipboard (single account = no ceremony; several = the existing account picker; feedback is one line `token copied to clipboard`; the token never prints to the transcript). - Connect flow updated: the PAT paste hint explains direct-PAT mode (device flow stays recommended); a dead PAT surfaces at the model fetch ("no models for this PAT — check Copilot Requests permission/seat") instead of a forecast exchange 404. ### Key decisions - **PAT mode lives in the token source**: `CopilotTokenManager.get()` short-circuits PATs (no exchange, no cache, no refresh); `copilotRequestHeaders()` dispatches request headers by token shape — an exchanged token keeps the `vscode-chat` identity byte-for-byte, a PAT presents `copilot-developer-cli`. The 401/403 refresh-retry is skipped in PAT mode (nothing to refresh — no doomed retry). - The `/models` dialect gets the same split: PAT → `GET {configured-base}/models` with PAT headers; OAuth → existing exchange + `proxy-ep` derivation, untouched. - Version/OS for the user-agent are host-installed at startup (`installCopilotCliIdentity` in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`) — `lib/` stays pure Dart. - Clipboard writes go through a new `clipboard_writer.dart` (pbcopy / xclip→wl-copy / clip; the token rides **stdin**, never argv) behind the same web-safe conditional-import pattern as the pasteboard reader, plus an `AgentCliConfig.clipboardWrite` test seam. - OAuth path unchanged: exchange, proactive ~30-min refresh, 401 refresh+retry all preserved (existing tests green). ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/providers/copilot_test.dart # PAT mode group: no exchange, PAT bearer + identity headers, chat + /models dart test test/cli/copilot_provider_test.dart test/cli/clipboard_writer_test.dart ``` Docs: `docs/agents/providers.md` (new "GitHub Copilot credentials" table — device flow recommended / `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN` env as OAuth or fine-grained PAT / classic `ghp_` never supported), README Copilot section, CHANGELOG under Unreleased. **Not verified here**: the live smoke against a real Copilot Business seat (AC2) — this ephemeral CI runner holds no Copilot-seat credential; AC1's mocked-http tests cover the wire shape the smoke would check.

The 401/403 refresh-retry is skipped in PAT mode (nothing to refresh — no doomed retry). - The `/models` dialect gets the same split: PAT → `GET {configured-base}/models` with PAT headers; OAuth → existing exchange + `proxy-ep` derivation, untouched. - Version/OS for the user-agent are host-installed at startup (`installCopilotCliIdentity` in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`) — `lib/` stays pure Dart. - Clipboard writes go through a new `clipboard_writer.dart` (pbcopy / xclip→wl-copy / clip; the token rides **stdin**, never argv) behind the same web-safe conditional-import pattern as the pasteboard reader, plus an `AgentCliConfig.clipboardWrite` test seam. - OAuth path unchanged: exchange, proactive ~30-min refresh, 401 refresh+retry all preserved (existing tests green). ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/providers/copilot_test.dart # PAT mode group: no exchange, PAT bearer + identity headers, chat + /models dart test test/cli/copilot_provider_test.dart test/cli/clipboard_writer_test.dart ``` Docs: `docs/agents/providers.md` (new "GitHub Copilot credentials" table — device flow recommended / `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN` env as OAuth or fine-grained PAT / classic `ghp_` never supported), README Copilot section, CHANGELOG under Unreleased. **Not verified here**: the live smoke against a real Copilot Business seat (AC2) — this ephemeral CI runner holds no Copilot-seat credential; AC1's mocked-http tests cover the wire shape the smoke would check.

{"content":"# gh-1606 — Copilot provider: fine-grained PAT support (PAT mode) + `/provider export` ### What changed - The `copilot` provider now accepts fine-grained PATs (`github_pat_…`) **directly**: when the GitHub credential is a PAT, the `copilot_internal/v2/token` exchange is skipped entirely and the raw PAT rides as the Bearer against the configured Copilot base URL (the seat's tier host — a PAT has no `proxy-ep` to learn a tenant host from), with the official Copilot CLI's first-party identity headers (`copilot-integration-id: copilot-developer-cli`, `user-agent: copilot/ () term/unknown`). This is the only request shape the Copilot API accepts a PAT with; `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN=github_pat_…` now works headless. - New `/provider export`: copies the saved Copilot account's full token to the clipboard (single account = no ceremony; several = the existing account picker; feedback is one line `token copied to clipboard`; the token never prints to the transcript). - Connect flow updated: the PAT paste hint explains direct-PAT mode (device flow stays recommended); a dead PAT surfaces at the model fetch ("no models for this PAT — check Copilot Requests permission/seat") instead of a forecast exchange 404. ### Key decisions - **PAT mode lives in the token source**: `CopilotTokenManager.get()` short-circuits PATs (no exchange, no cache, no refresh); `copilotRequestHeaders()` dispatches request headers by token shape — an exchanged token keeps the `vscode-chat` identity byte-for-byte, a PAT presents `copilot-developer-cli`. The 401/403 refresh-retry is skipped in PAT mode (nothing to refresh — no doomed retry). - The `/models` dialect gets the same split: PAT → `GET {configured-base}/models` with PAT headers; OAuth → existing exchange + `proxy-ep` derivation, untouched. - Version/OS for the user-agent are host-installed at startup (`installCopilotCliIdentity` in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`) — `lib/` stays pure Dart. - Clipboard writes go through a new `clipboard_writer.dart` (pbcopy / xclip→wl-copy / clip; the token rides **stdin**, never argv) behind the same web-safe conditional-import pattern as the pasteboard reader, plus an `AgentCliConfig.clipboardWrite` test seam. - OAuth path unchanged: exchange, proactive ~30-min refresh, 401 refresh+retry all preserved (existing tests green). ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/providers/copilot_test.dart # PAT mode group: no exchange, PAT bearer + identity headers, chat + /models dart test test/cli/copilot_provider_test.dart test/cli/clipboard_writer_test.dart ``` Docs: `docs/agents/providers.md` (new "GitHub Copilot credentials" table — device flow recommended / `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN` env as OAuth or fine-grained PAT / classic `ghp_` never supported), README Copilot section, CHANGELOG under Unreleased. **Not verified here**: the live smoke against a real Copilot Business seat (AC2) — this ephemeral CI runner holds no Copilot-seat credential; AC1's mocked-http tests cover the wire shape the smoke would check.
Request flow ```mermaid flowchart TD CRED[GitHub credential] -->|gho_/ghu_ OAuth| EX[POST copilot_internal/v2/token exchange] EX --> TOK[~30-min Copilot API token + proxy-ep host] CRED -->|github_pat_ PAT| PAT[raw PAT is the Bearer] TOK --> API[copilot API base URL] PAT --> API API --> HDR[vscode-chat identity · OAuth
copilot-developer-cli + copilot/<version> UA · PAT] HDR --> MODELS[GET /models] HDR --> CHAT[POST /chat/completions] ```

This is the only request shape the Copilot API accepts a PAT with; `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN=github_pat_…` now works headless. - New `/provider export`: copies the saved Copilot account's full token to the clipboard (single account = no ceremony; several = the existing account picker; feedback is one line `token copied to clipboard`; the token never prints to the transcript). - Connect flow updated: the PAT paste hint explains direct-PAT mode (device flow stays recommended); a dead PAT surfaces at the model fetch ("no models for this PAT — check Copilot Requests permission/seat") instead of a forecast exchange 404. ### Key decisions - **PAT mode lives in the token source**: `CopilotTokenManager.get()` short-circuits PATs (no exchange, no cache, no refresh); `copilotRequestHeaders()` dispatches request headers by token shape — an exchanged token keeps the `vscode-chat` identity byte-for-byte, a PAT presents `copilot-developer-cli`. The 401/403 refresh-retry is skipped in PAT mode (nothing to refresh — no doomed retry). - The `/models` dialect gets the same split: PAT → `GET {configured-base}/models` with PAT headers; OAuth → existing exchange + `proxy-ep` derivation, untouched. - Version/OS for the user-agent are host-installed at startup (`installCopilotCliIdentity` in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`) — `lib/` stays pure Dart. - Clipboard writes go through a new `clipboard_writer.dart` (pbcopy / xclip→wl-copy / clip; the token rides **stdin**, never argv) behind the same web-safe conditional-import pattern as the pasteboard reader, plus an `AgentCliConfig.clipboardWrite` test seam. - OAuth path unchanged: exchange, proactive ~30-min refresh, 401 refresh+retry all preserved (existing tests green). ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/providers/copilot_test.dart # PAT mode group: no exchange, PAT bearer + identity headers, chat + /models dart test test/cli/copilot_provider_test.dart test/cli/clipboard_writer_test.dart ``` Docs: `docs/agents/providers.md` (new "GitHub Copilot credentials" table — device flow recommended / `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN` env as OAuth or fine-grained PAT / classic `ghp_` never supported), README Copilot section, CHANGELOG under Unreleased. **Not verified here**: the live smoke against a real Copilot Business seat (AC2) — this ephemeral CI runner holds no Copilot-seat credential; AC1's mocked-http tests cover the wire shape the smoke would check.

{"content":"# gh-1606 — Copilot provider: fine-grained PAT support (PAT mode) + `/provider export` ### What changed - The `copilot` provider now accepts fine-grained PATs (`github_pat_…`) **directly**: when the GitHub credential is a PAT, the `copilot_internal/v2/token` exchange is skipped entirely and the raw PAT rides as the Bearer against the configured Copilot base URL (the seat's tier host — a PAT has no `proxy-ep` to learn a tenant host from), with the official Copilot CLI's first-party identity headers (`copilot-integration-id: copilot-developer-cli`, `user-agent: copilot/ () term/unknown`). This is the only request shape the Copilot API accepts a PAT with; `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN=github_pat_…` now works headless. - New `/provider export`: copies the saved Copilot account's full token to the clipboard (single account = no ceremony; several = the existing account picker; feedback is one line `token copied to clipboard`; the token never prints to the transcript). - Connect flow updated: the PAT paste hint explains direct-PAT mode (device flow stays recommended); a dead PAT surfaces at the model fetch ("no models for this PAT — check Copilot Requests permission/seat") instead of a forecast exchange 404. ### Key decisions - **PAT mode lives in the token source**: `CopilotTokenManager.get()` short-circuits PATs (no exchange, no cache, no refresh); `copilotRequestHeaders()` dispatches request headers by token shape — an exchanged token keeps the `vscode-chat` identity byte-for-byte, a PAT presents `copilot-developer-cli`. The 401/403 refresh-retry is skipped in PAT mode (nothing to refresh — no doomed retry). - The `/models` dialect gets the same split: PAT → `GET {configured-base}/models` with PAT headers; OAuth → existing exchange + `proxy-ep` derivation, untouched. - Version/OS for the user-agent are host-installed at startup (`installCopilotCliIdentity` in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`) — `lib/` stays pure Dart. - Clipboard writes go through a new `clipboard_writer.dart` (pbcopy / xclip→wl-copy / clip; the token rides **stdin**, never argv) behind the same web-safe conditional-import pattern as the pasteboard reader, plus an `AgentCliConfig.clipboardWrite` test seam. - OAuth path unchanged: exchange, proactive ~30-min refresh, 401 refresh+retry all preserved (existing tests green). ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/providers/copilot_test.dart # PAT mode group: no exchange, PAT bearer + identity headers, chat + /models dart test test/cli/copilot_provider_test.dart test/cli/clipboard_writer_test.dart ``` Docs: `docs/agents/providers.md` (new "GitHub Copilot credentials" table — device flow recommended / `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN` env as OAuth or fine-grained PAT / classic `ghp_` never supported), README Copilot section, CHANGELOG under Unreleased. **Not verified here**: the live smoke against a real Copilot Business seat (AC2) — this ephemeral CI runner holds no Copilot-seat credential; AC1's mocked-http tests cover the wire shape the smoke would check.

{"content":"# gh-1606 — Copilot provider: fine-grained PAT support (PAT mode) + `/provider export` ### What changed - The `copilot` provider now accepts fine-grained PATs (`github_pat_…`) **directly**: when the GitHub credential is a PAT, the `copilot_internal/v2/token` exchange is skipped entirely and the raw PAT rides as the Bearer against the configured Copilot base URL (the seat's tier host — a PAT has no `proxy-ep` to learn a tenant host from), with the official Copilot CLI's first-party identity headers (`copilot-integration-id: copilot-developer-cli`, `user-agent: copilot/ () term/unknown`). This is the only request shape the Copilot API accepts a PAT with; `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN=github_pat_…` now works headless. - New `/provider export`: copies the saved Copilot account's full token to the clipboard (single account = no ceremony; several = the existing account picker; feedback is one line `token copied to clipboard`; the token never prints to the transcript). - Connect flow updated: the PAT paste hint explains direct-PAT mode (device flow stays recommended); a dead PAT surfaces at the model fetch ("no models for this PAT — check Copilot Requests permission/seat") instead of a forecast exchange 404. ### Key decisions - **PAT mode lives in the token source**: `CopilotTokenManager.get()` short-circuits PATs (no exchange, no cache, no refresh); `copilotRequestHeaders()` dispatches request headers by token shape — an exchanged token keeps the `vscode-chat` identity byte-for-byte, a PAT presents `copilot-developer-cli`. The 401/403 refresh-retry is skipped in PAT mode (nothing to refresh — no doomed retry). - The `/models` dialect gets the same split: PAT → `GET {configured-base}/models` with PAT headers; OAuth → existing exchange + `proxy-ep` derivation, untouched. - Version/OS for the user-agent are host-installed at startup (`installCopilotCliIdentity` in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`) — `lib/` stays pure Dart. - Clipboard writes go through a new `clipboard_writer.dart` (pbcopy / xclip→wl-copy / clip; the token rides **stdin**, never argv) behind the same web-safe conditional-import pattern as the pasteboard reader, plus an `AgentCliConfig.clipboardWrite` test seam. - OAuth path unchanged: exchange, proactive ~30-min refresh, 401 refresh+retry all preserved (existing tests green). ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/providers/copilot_test.dart # PAT mode group: no exchange, PAT bearer + identity headers, chat + /models dart test test/cli/copilot_provider_test.dart test/cli/clipboard_writer_test.dart ``` Docs: `docs/agents/providers.md` (new "GitHub Copilot credentials" table — device flow recommended / `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN` env as OAuth or fine-grained PAT / classic `ghp_` never supported), README Copilot section, CHANGELOG under Unreleased. **Not verified here**: the live smoke against a real Copilot Business seat (AC2) — this ephemeral CI runner holds no Copilot-seat credential; AC1's mocked-http tests cover the wire shape the smoke would check.

{"content":"# gh-1606 — Copilot provider: fine-grained PAT support (PAT mode) + `/provider export` ### What changed - The `copilot` provider now accepts fine-grained PATs (`github_pat_…`) **directly**: when the GitHub credential is a PAT, the `copilot_internal/v2/token` exchange is skipped entirely and the raw PAT rides as the Bearer against the configured Copilot base URL (the seat's tier host — a PAT has no `proxy-ep` to learn a tenant host from), with the official Copilot CLI's first-party identity headers (`copilot-integration-id: copilot-developer-cli`, `user-agent: copilot/ () term/unknown`). This is the only request shape the Copilot API accepts a PAT with; `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN=github_pat_…` now works headless. - New `/provider export`: copies the saved Copilot account's full token to the clipboard (single account = no ceremony; several = the existing account picker; feedback is one line `token copied to clipboard`; the token never prints to the transcript). - Connect flow updated: the PAT paste hint explains direct-PAT mode (device flow stays recommended); a dead PAT surfaces at the model fetch ("no models for this PAT — check Copilot Requests permission/seat") instead of a forecast exchange 404. ### Key decisions - **PAT mode lives in the token source**: `CopilotTokenManager.get()` short-circuits PATs (no exchange, no cache, no refresh); `copilotRequestHeaders()` dispatches request headers by token shape — an exchanged token keeps the `vscode-chat` identity byte-for-byte, a PAT presents `copilot-developer-cli`. The 401/403 refresh-retry is skipped in PAT mode (nothing to refresh — no doomed retry). - The `/models` dialect gets the same split: PAT → `GET {configured-base}/models` with PAT headers; OAuth → existing exchange + `proxy-ep` derivation, untouched. - Version/OS for the user-agent are host-installed at startup (`installCopilotCliIdentity` in `bin/fah_runapp.dart`) — `lib/` stays pure Dart. - Clipboard writes go through a new `clipboard_writer.dart` (pbcopy / xclip→wl-copy / clip; the token rides **stdin**, never argv) behind the same web-safe conditional-import pattern as the pasteboard reader, plus an `AgentCliConfig.clipboardWrite` test seam. - OAuth path unchanged: exchange, proactive ~30-min refresh, 401 refresh+retry all preserved (existing tests green). ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/providers/copilot_test.dart # PAT mode group: no exchange, PAT bearer + identity headers, chat + /models dart test test/cli/copilot_provider_test.dart test/cli/clipboard_writer_test.dart ``` Docs: `docs/agents/providers.md` (new "GitHub Copilot credentials" table — device flow recommended / `COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN` env as OAuth or fine-grained PAT / classic `ghp_` never supported), README Copilot section, CHANGELOG under Unreleased. **Not verified here**: the live smoke against a real Copilot Business seat (AC2) — this ephemeral CI runner holds no Copilot-seat credential; AC1's mocked-http tests cover the wire shape the smoke would check.
Request flow ```mermaid flowchart TD CRED[GitHub credential] -->|gho_/ghu_ OAuth| EX[POST copilot_internal/v2/token exchange] EX --> TOK[~30-min Copilot API token + proxy-ep host] CRED -->|github_pat_ PAT| PAT[raw PAT is the Bearer] TOK --> API[copilot API base URL] PAT --> API API --> HDR[vscode-chat identity · OAuth
copilot-developer-cli + copilot/<version> UA · PAT] HDR --> MODELS[GET /models] HDR --> CHAT[POST /chat/completions] ```
